out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE BACK HANDWASHING SINK NEAR THE THREE-VAT SINK NOT ABLE TO PROVIDE ANY WATER.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC INFORMED EHS THAT A WORK ORDER HAD ALREADY BEEN PLACED FOR THE HANDWASHING SINK. PLEASE ENSURE THAT PROOF OF CORRECTION IS PROVIDED TO THE EHS WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE HANDWASHING SINK NEAR THE RIGHT SIDE OF THE COOK-LINE AND THE BACK HANDWASHING SINK NEAR THREE-VAT SINK NEEDING TO BE CAULKED AGAIN.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PLEASE ENSURE THE SINKS ARE CAULKED AGAIN PRIOR TO YOUR NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. MANAGER WAS UNABLE TO PROVIDE HIS CFM CERTIFICATE.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. OBTAIN A FOOD SAFETY MANAGER CERTIFICATE BY MARCH 2, 2026.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: OBSERVED BOTH THE CHEMICAL DISHMACHINE AND HOT WATER SANITIZING DISH MACHINE (148F) TO NOT BE SANITIZING AS REQUIRED. OBSERVED THE SANITIZING EQUIPMENT AT THE THREE-VAT SINK TO NOT BE FUNCTIONAL.
violations.corrective_action: MANAGERS HAVE CONTACTED ECOLAB FOR REPAIR MULTIPLE TIMES, AND A TECHNICIAN CAME ON 2/18/26 BUT DID NOT REPAIR EQUIPMENT. EHS AND PIC SPOKE TO ECOLAB DURING INSPECTION AND REQUESTED EMERGENCY SERVICE. BOTH DISHMACHINES AND THE SANITIZING EQUIPMENT AT THE THREE-VAT SINK MUST BE REPAIRED BY MARCH 2, 2026. UNTIL THAT TIME, YOU MUST SANITIZE ALL EQUIPMENT IN THE THREE-VAT SINK WITH THE POURED LACTIC ACID SANITIZER.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED AN UNAPPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CDI: SPLITTER REMOVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE PURCHASE AN ASSE 1055B PRESSURE BLEED VALVE TO HAVE TWO HOSES ATTACHED TO SINK AT THE SAME TIME.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE GREASE TRAP TO BE FULL AND UNABLE TO BE USED. FACILITY HAS BEEN DISPOSING OF GREASE IN THE TRASH.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. YOUR GREASE TRAP MUST BE CLEANED AND CLEANED AT A HIGHER FREQUENCY TO PRECLUDE A FULL TRAP. THIS MUST BE COMPLETED BY MARCH 2, 2026.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE FAUCET AT THE THREE-VAT SINK IN THE KITCHEN LEAKING CONSIDERABLY WHEN TURNED ON.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. REPAIR FAUCET LEAK BY MARCH 2, 2026. REPAIR MUST BE COMPLETED IN ACCORDANCE WITH LAW AND LOCAL REGULATION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED A SIGNIFICANT NUMBER OF FRUIT FLIES SWARMING AT THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC STATED PEST CONTROL IS COMING 9/2/25. PEST CONTROL MUST TREAT FACILITY FOR FRUIT FLIES AND METHODS MUST BE PUT IN PLACE TO CONTROL THEM.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: OBSERVED COMMERCIAL SANITIZER MACHINE AT BAR THREE-VAT SINK NOT TO BE WORKING.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CEASE USING THIS MACHINE UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED OR REPLACED TO SANITIZE AT 50-200PPM CHLORINE OR 150-400PPM QUATERNARY AMMONIA.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the bar being used as a dump sink
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC EXPLAINED TO EMPLOYEES NOT TO USE THE HAND SINK AS A DUMP SINK.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.
